observations: I opened assets/panels/07-2.png, main-cast.png and page-07.png and looked at them myself. Ravi is shown chest-up at the reception desk, holding his dark-blue-cased phone in both hands at chest height with the screen toward the reader. He glances up and away to screen-right, curious and hopeful, with his mouth open as he speaks. His face matches his sheet.

His left hand, with the wristwatch, supports the lower-right corner of the phone. His right hand wraps the left edge. Both match the production notes. The thumbs and fingers read correctly. The bag strap is on his shoulder.

The phone screen shows a calendar icon card and a heart icon card with blank blocks. I found no text or personal data. The reception monitor at the left is seen from the side. The background shows waiting chairs and figures seen mostly from behind. Meera is correctly off panel.

On page-07.png the balloon tail points to Ravi's mouth. The WELBUK HEALTH label sits over the background to the left of the phone, very close to its left edge but not covering it. His face and hands are uncovered.
